In addition, the consultant may be asked to carry out ad-hoc tasks related to the assessment of other interconnected elements that are to be included in the impact assessment. In diesem Zusammenhang muss auch das Vergütungskonzept für EEMD-Anbieter weiterentwickelt werden. .
